extension.description: Widget folders for skins such as Arctic Fuse 2, built like the JELLYNAS Jellyfin home page. Continue watching and Spotlight come from the Jellyfin server with the Kofin login of this Kodi (read only); episodes show the series name. This week comes from Streambox (week.json), IMDb ratings from Streambox (imdb.json). Playback goes through Kofin.

Widget-mappák skinekhez (pl. Arctic Fuse 2), a JELLYNAS Jellyfin-kezdőlapja mintájára. A Megtekintés folytatása és a Kiemelt a Jellyfin-szerverről jön, ennek a Kodinak a Kofin-belépésével (csak olvasás); a részeknél a sorozat neve látszik. Az Ezen a héten a Streamboxból (week.json), az IMDb-pontszámok a Streamboxból (imdb.json) jönnek. A lejátszást a Kofin végzi.
extension.news: 0.1.8: All movies and All series take the Home grid bar filters of the JELLYNAS skin: sort (newest, title, year, IMDb rating), first letter, unwatched only, genre (chosen in a dialog from the Jellyfin genres). 0.1.7: New folders All movies and All series: the whole library newest first for a category poster wall (Poster Wall view), with the IMDb badge, watched mark, unwatched episode count and the Kodi sort menu (date added, title, year, rating, play count); a series opens its seasons in Kofin. 0.1.6: This week info panel like the other rows: an available episode shows its own Jellyfin overview, length and streams, the others the series overview. 0.1.5: New folders Next up, Recently added movies, Recently added series (as on the Jellyfin home page, with the IMDb value; a series card opens its seasons in Kofin); This week cards carry an Available badge instead of IMDb. 0.1.4: This week without day cards: the day and time (TODAY for today) in the second line of each card, the state in the plot. 0.1.3: This week: series images with their real tags (backdrop when no Thumb), day cards with the day name. 0.1.2: works through the public address (own User-Agent, the proxy refused the default one). 0.1.1: the language setting is saved (new settings format), new icon. 0.1.0: first version: Continue watching, Spotlight, This week
